planning_notes: Mapping rule (A0 ADC 0..1023 linear floor to 0..9999) and enforcing display update <=50ms after input change are model responsibilities; the analog_input is sampled and the model performs scaling and integer flooring, then updates tm1637_number.

TM1637 display must be always turned on per requirement; tm1637_number uses invalid_policy='blank' but the model should avoid setting invalid states for this mapping so the display stays active with the computed integer. If library semantics differ for 'blank', adjust model to keep a valid value continuously.
No explicit serial I/O requirements were provided; therefore serial_channels is empty.
No other wiring beyond A0->analog_input and D4/D5->TM1637 was specified; therefore no additional port/interface requests are created.
Timing: control_period_ms=10ms is chosen as scheduling granularity; the model should sample/pipeline such that end-to-end display latency (including TM1637 bus transfer) stays <=50ms.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: A0 potentiometer ADC mapped source for TM1637 display (raw 0..1023 -> model maps to 0..9999)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 displays mapped A0 value as full decimal 0..9999 (no required forced leading-zero behavior; allowed to show leading zeros or blank as model decides)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
将 A0 电位器的模拟值映射到 0 到 9999，并显示在 TM1637 数码管上，模块引脚为 CLK=D4，DIO=D5。
验收约定：A0真实ADC读数0..1023线性映射为0..9999整数，向下取整；TM1637显示完整十进制数，允许前导零或空白。CLK=D4、DIO=D5，显示始终开启。输入变化后的显示响应时间不超过50ms，包括库的总线传输时间。
